genericRepairs.rule: A technical process explicitly installed as an arm to modify a result retains INTERVENTION semantic type and its independent arm role.
A result explicitly targeted for modification is OUTCOME without endpoint promotion.
A named target directly observed or measured remains SCIENTIFIC_OBJECT unless its mechanism/process is the question.
A bare evolution/change request without time point is SCIENTIFIC_INTENT.
Critic audits composite acquisition concepts and clinical states against the source independently of the initial inventory.
